name: Generic Identification 44
definition: Information related to the identification of an individual person.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Name or number assigned by an entity to enable recognition of that entity, eg, account identifier.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the nature of the identification.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date at which the identification was issued.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date at which the identification expires.
